name: console-get-logs
description: Recent Unity Console entries. Filter severity with levels; use contains for message text search. Output counts: matched=raw entries matching filters; groups=distinct entries after dedupe; count=entries returned (after maxEntries + size limits); dropped=groups omitted; each entry's repeats=duplicates collapsed. See sinceEventId for freshness filtering.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the message text. Caveat: an exact single word error/exception/warning/issue (or their plurals) is instead treated as a severity filter, not text search — use levels for severity, and add another word if you truly need to grep for that text.

sinceEventId.description: Only return logs with an event cursor greater than this. Capture lastEventId (here or from bridge-get-status) before a compile/reimport to separate fresh logs from stale. Matches only bridge-captured logs (Console/Editor.log rows lack a cursor).

sinceTimestampUtc.description: Only return logs at/after this UTC timestamp (ISO 8601). Prefer sinceEventId; Console/Editor.log timestamps reflect read time, not capture time.

dedupe.description: Collapse identical entries into one row with a repeats count. Default on. Set false to see every raw occurrence.

includeStack.description: Include each entry's full stack trace inline. Use this instead of console-get-logs-single when a per-frame exception is churning the buffer (an id can be evicted before the follow-up call lands).
